calendar_identifier.description: EventKit EKCalendar identifier (calendarIdentifier) the adapter polls and writes to. Resolved from the OS-level Calendar.app account at bootstrap (prompt 16 wizard).

member_id.description: Household member whose EventKit grant this adapter uses. Drives the central-pack's owner_member_id sharing discriminator on the future calendar projection.

provider_account_id.description: Stable alias for the member's iCloud/local EventKit account.

deployment_target.description: Dual-deployment runtime selector per [D18] / [D22] / memo 04 §2.2 (11b-ii-β-β). `central` (default, backwards-compatible): adapter runs on the shared CoS Apple ID Mac Mini and emits via ctx.event_log.append; sharing_model value `shared_central`. `bridge`: adapter runs on a per-member bridge Mac Mini signed into that member's iCloud; the bridge connector-pack wrapper (bridge/adminme_bridge/connector_packs/calendaring_apple_calendar_bridge/) injects an IngestClientBridgeSink into the synthesized AdapterContext so the adapter emits via the α-1 bridge sink; sharing_model value `per_member_isolated`. Pre-β-β configs that omit this field default to `central` so existing instances keep working.

poll_window_days.description: Forward-looking window (days from now) for the EKEventStore predicate. Defaults to 30; tune up for long-horizon planning.

poll_interval_s.description: In-process inbound-poll cadence in seconds. Defaults to 60s; pack.yaml's cron is a heartbeat the supervisor uses to detect a wedged adapter.

sensitivity_floor.description: Adapter sensitivity floor. Config may RAISE the floor but cannot LOWER it below the hardcoded class default per SYSTEM_INVARIANTS.md §6 invariant 10.
